Row.Text: Hall family wealth and Spectator powers guide one city's development.
Once established, gain +15 Gold per turn for your empire; this city's Gold yields increase by 20%.

While established and not neutralized, prevents random loss of control for your Pathway Holder and clears an existing loss of control. Positive states can still occur and retain their original duration. Sealed Artifacts are unaffected.
+50% Great Writer, Artist and Musician points in the established city; +4 Gold for each Great Work of Writing there.
At 100 Loyalty, the established city gains +25% Food and Production. Below 100 Loyalty, it gains +10 Loyalty per turn instead.
Every 7 active player turns, grant 1 Envoy to the Church of the Fool. The counter pauses during reassignment or neutralization.
Every 7 active player turns, complete one currently legal Building, Wonder or Project in the established city. Preserves prior production progress. Expires this turn.
Justice prevented the Holder's loss of control. Positive states are unaffected.
Select a Building, Wonder or Project for production in Justice's city, then press Complete to finish it immediately. The old item need not stay queued. One use this turn.
Story Arrangement is not currently available.
Choose a producible Building, Wonder or Project in Justice's city first. Units and Districts are not eligible.
Completion failed; the opportunity is retained. Select the production item again and retry.
